thread:
Maria Chen: Quick follow-up from the oncall incident: hosted->dedicated->private hops are losing the delegation context (who signed the request) and that breaks RBAC in private. We need a clear boundary contract for header propagation.
Li Wei: Yep. The sidecars and gateways currently have different allowlists. Some strips Authorization, others pass it. That's the root cause.
Sam Patel: We can't forward raw Authorization across all hops for security. We should introduce a short-lived delegation token header that proxies mint and verify. Suggest `x-rw-delegation: <opaque-id>` with OAuth-ish introspection in control-plane.
Jess Martin: Security: fine if tokens are scoped and short-lived, but must be bound to connection and only accepted by our internal services. Also must never be relayed to customer origin.
Noor Sadiq: Customer impact: some enterprise customers use their own identity headers for auditing. If we strip them, their audit trails break. We'd better have opt-in mapping rules per tenant.
Ben O'Neill: Proposal: three-part contract: 1) forwardable-internal-headers list (names we allow across internal hops); 2) delegation token spec (`x-rw-delegation-v=1; id=<id>; sig=<sig>`); 3) tenant mapping config (for private) to map forwarded internal headers -> customer-visible audit fields.
Maria Chen: Also need failure semantics: if delegation token missing or invalid, private should return 403 vs hosted returning 502. The contract should state canonical error codes so clients can distinguish authz vs transport failure.
Li Wei: Implementation note: proxies will have feature flag `rw.allow_delegation_header` and `rw.rewrite_auth_for_private` boolean. We'll default off and roll gradually.
Sam Patel: For the delegation token lifecycle: control-plane mints token when routing to downstream control-plane or runtime. Token contains: issuer, tenant, expiry (<=30s), and optional route-hash. We'll sign with KMS. Private sidecar will verify signature rather than call home.
Jess Martin: Make sure KMS keys used for signing are region-isolated for private deployments (customers may want BYOK). We need to support key rotation and local verification bundles.
Ben O'Neill: Test plan: unit tests for header strip/forward matrix, e2e with dedicated->private in a staging cluster, and a fuzz test for malformed delegation tokens. Also update compatibility matrix for older sidecars.
Noor Sadiq: Can we surface this in the Console as a per-tenant toggle with a short explanation? Ops teams will want to enable mapping only after testing.
tracer-bot: trace: added span attribute `rw.delegation.id` for requests carrying delegation tokens.
ops-bot: alert-suggestion: watch for spikes in 403 and new error header `x-rw-error` when rollout begins.
Sam Patel: One more: need to define which headers are NEVER forwarded (PII) and which are allowed only if tenant opts in. I'll draft the allowlist and never-forward list.
Maria Chen: Action items I will own: draft RFC including header list, delegation token format, error code mapping, feature flags, and rollout plan. Jess, please add security checklist. Li, add proxy flags and a dev timeline. Ben, add tests. Noor, prepare Console toggle copy.
Jess Martin: SGTM. Also schedule a 30m security review before enabling the feature flag in staging.
Ben O'Neill: We'll gate rollout on the fuzz-test results and a low error-rate window.
Maria Chen: Thanks — logging follow-ups in the RFC PR. Ill link it here when ready.
Noor Sadiq: Thanks  — will prep customer comms draft once RFC is stable.
Sam Patel: +1 :rocket:
